$comment: UTMStack MCP Module — reference catalog of every tool, resource, and prompt the server exposes (or will expose). Each tool entry maps to the underlying usecase method, declares its permission/license gate, and includes a JSON-Schema-style input shape. status='implemented' tools are wired in modules/mcp/tools_*.go today; status='planned' tools are scaffolded by the design but not yet registered.

server.name: utmstack
server.title: UTMStack
server.description: UTMStack backend exposed over MCP. Lets MCP-aware AI tools drive the same SOC operations a user would over REST — search alerts, run SOAR rules, query OpenSearch, manage incidents, generate compliance reports — under the same auth, permissions, license gates, and audit log.
server.auth: Bearer JWT or Utm-Api-Key header — same as REST. The caller's Actor (UserID, Login, Roles, Permissions) is propagated into every tool invocation and enforced via pkg/authz.
server.audit: Every tool call writes one row to the audit_log table with EventType=MCP_TOOL_CALL and ResourceType=<tool name>.

permissions.alerts.read: List/search alerts and the tag catalog.
permissions.alerts.write: Mutate alerts (status, notes, tags) and tag rules.
permissions.incidents.write: Create/modify incidents and their alert links/notes.
permissions.soar.read: Read SOAR rules, templates, executions, variables, actions, jobs.
permissions.soar.write: Mutate SOAR rules and run actions/jobs (may dispatch commands to agents).
permissions.opensearch.read: Search OpenSearch via the FilterType DSL or SQL; read indices and policy.
permissions.opensearch.write: Delete indices, manage index patterns, update ISM policy.
permissions.loganalyzer.read: Run analyzer queries and load saved queries.
permissions.eventprocessing.read: Read regex patterns, tenant configs, correlation rules, filters, ingestion stats.
permissions.eventprocessing.write: Mutate regex patterns, tenant configs, correlation rules, filters.
permissions.compliance.read: Read frameworks, controls, reports, and schedules.
permissions.compliance.write: Mutate frameworks/controls; generate reports; manage schedules.
permissions.config.write: Update app config and branding (branding write also requires MSSP).
permissions.idp.write: Mutate identity providers (also requires Enterprise license).
permissions.ROLE_ADMIN: Administrative role gate (license upload, connection keys).
permissions.ENTERPRISE: Active license edition must be Enterprise.
permissions.MSSP: Active license must have MSSP enabled.

annotation_semantics.readOnlyHint: true when the tool does not mutate any state.
annotation_semantics.idempotentHint: true when repeated identical calls have the same effect as one call.
annotation_semantics.destructiveHint: true when the tool may perform irrecoverable changes (deletes, dispatched commands).
annotation_semantics.openWorldHint: true when the tool may interact with external systems (OpenSearch, agents, mail, SOC-AI service).

tools.name: alerts.update_status
tools.title: Update alert status
tools.description: Change the status of one or more alerts (open / in-review / closed). Records the change in alert history and optionally tags closed alerts as false-positive.

alert_ids.description: OpenSearch _id values of the alerts to update

tools.name: alerts.update_notes
tools.title: Replace alert notes
tools.description: Replace the analyst notes attached to a single alert.

tools.name: alerts.update_tags
tools.title: Set tags on alerts
tools.description: Replace the tag list on one or more alerts. If create_rule=true, also persists a tag rule so future matching alerts are auto-tagged.

tools.name: alerts.convert_to_incident
tools.title: Attach alerts to an incident
tools.description: Convert/attach alerts to an incident — either by creating a new one (incident_id=0) or appending to an existing one.

tools.name: alerts.count_open
tools.title: Count open alerts
tools.description: Return the current count of alerts in the OPEN status across all indices.

tools.name: alerts.search_adversary
tools.title: Search alerts grouped by adversary
tools.description: Return alerts grouped by adversary host. Each entry surfaces the parent alert plus its correlated children.
tools.output: AdversaryResponse[] — each containing { adversary: Side, alerts: [{ alert, children[] }] }

tools.name: alert_tag_rules.create
tools.title: Create alert tag rule
tools.description: Persist a rule that auto-applies tags to alerts matching the given FilterType conditions.

tools.name: alert_tag_rules.get
tools.title: Get alert tag rule by ID

tools.name: incidents.add_alerts
tools.title: Attach alerts to an existing incident

tools.name: incidents.users_assigned
tools.title: List users currently assigned to incidents

tools.name: soar.job.create
tools.title: Create SOAR job
tools.description: Schedules an action command for execution on a target agent. DESTRUCTIVE: triggers a real command on the agent.

tools.name: opensearch.search
tools.title: Structured search
tools.description: Run a search against the configured index pattern using the FilterType DSL (see mcp://utmstack/docs/filter-operators). Returns paged hits.

tools.name: opensearch.search_sql
tools.title: SQL search
tools.description: Run a sanitized SQL query against the OpenSearch SQL plugin.

tools.name: opensearch.search_csv
tools.title: Search and project to CSV columns
tools.output: object[] — rows projected to the requested columns

tools.name: datasources.usage
tools.title: Datasource usage vs license
tools.output: { count: int64, limit: int64, unlimited: bool }

tools.name: integrations.tenants.delete
tools.title: Delete integration tenant config
tools.output: { module: string, name: string, deleted: true }

tools.name: socai.analyze_alert
tools.title: Forward an alert to SOC AI for analysis
tools.description: Forwards the alert payload to the configured external SOC AI service and returns its async ack. The remote service writes its conclusions back through the regular alerts/incidents pipeline.
tools.output: { status: string, alertId: string, message: string }

resources.name: Integrations catalog
resources.description: Live list of integration modules (data type, pretty name, category, active flag). Useful as context before calling integrations.activate.

resources.name: Compliance frameworks catalog
resources.description: File-backed compliance framework catalog (key, name, requirement count, enabled state).

resources.name: Alert tag catalog
resources.description: User-defined alert tags. Useful for prompting the LLM with the existing taxonomy before alerts.update_tags.

resources.name: FilterType operator reference
resources.description: Documentation of the structured FilterType DSL (IS, IS_NOT, CONTAIN, IS_BETWEEN, EXIST, …) used by opensearch.search, alerts.search_adversary, alert_tag_rules, loganalyzer.* and dashboards.

resources.name: Audit event-type enum
resources.description: Full list of ApplicationEventType values written by REST handlers and the MCP layer.

prompts.name: soc.triage-open-alerts
prompts.title: Triage open alerts
prompts.description: Pulls all open alerts grouped by adversary, asks the model to propose a status, tags, and (when appropriate) an incident for each adversary cluster, then awaits explicit user approval before applying the changes.

prompts.name: soc.investigate-alert
prompts.title: Investigate alert
prompts.description: Given an alert ID, pulls the alert, related events from OpenSearch, and any similar past incidents; the model then drafts an incident-creation payload for human approval.

arguments.name: alert_id
arguments.description: OpenSearch _id of the alert to investigate

prompts.name: soc.compliance-summary
prompts.title: Compliance summary
prompts.description: Generates a fresh report for the requested framework and turns it into a stakeholder-ready summary (gaps, owners, next steps).

prompts.name: soc.draft-soar-rule
prompts.title: Draft SOAR rule
prompts.description: Guides the model through SOAR rule construction: list available templates, list variables, propose filter conditions, then create the rule on confirmation.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: Plain-language goal for the rule (e.g. 'isolate hosts on Mimikatz detections')

FilterType.description: Structured query condition used across opensearch.*, alerts.*, loganalyzer.*, dashboards, eventprocessing.* tools.

value.description: Operator-dependent — string, number, [from,to] tuple, or string[]
